en: I have been living here for two months.
why: Llevar plus time plus a gerund says what you keep doing.

en: I have not slept in two days.
why: Without doing it is sin plus the infinitive.

en: Vale has been working here for a year.
es: Vale lleva un año trabajando aquí.
why: Llevar plus time plus a gerund.

en: Vale has not worked in a year.
es: Vale lleva un año sin trabajar.
why: The English says she has not worked.

en: We have been waiting for an hour.
why: Llevar plus time plus a gerund.

en: We have not eaten for an hour.
why: The English says we have not eaten.

en: Tomás has been cooking for hours.
Tomás has not cooked for weeks.
why: The English says he has not cooked.

en: I have not studied for three months.
why: The English says I have not studied.

en: Rosa has been calling you all day.
es: Rosa lleva todo el día llamándote.
why: She keeps calling, so the gerund.

en: Rosa has not called me in a week.
es: Rosa lleva una semana sin llamarme.
why: The English says she has not called.

en: Hernando has not come to the café for a month.
es: Hernando lleva un mes sin venir al café.
why: The English says he has not come.

en: Hernando has been coming to the café for years.
es: Hernando lleva años viniendo al café.
why: He keeps coming, so the gerund.

en: I have not seen my family for a year.
es: Llevo un año sin ver a mi familia.
why: The English says I have not seen.
